name: Platinum Vape | 1g 510 Live Resin | Acapulco Gold
description:
A true legend in the cannabis world. Acapulco Gold shines with rich, earthy notes layered with hints of sweet citrus and warm toffee. In live resin form, this classic sativa bursts with full-bodied flavor and uplifting potency. Known for its long-lasting, energetic high, Acapulco Gold sparks creativity, focus, and an all-around feel-good vibe—perfect for daytime adventures or sparking motivation.

Strain Type: Sativa

Flavor Notes: Earthy, sweet citrus, toffee

Effects: Uplifting, creative, motivating, euphoric
